verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a software product, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows a public source repository or an open-source license. The public, keyless OpenAPI spec and the llms.txt file are API and documentation artifacts, not product source code, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
